title: Key Functional Committees
content:
DAVIET publishes several functional committees on its official Functional Committees page. Examples and published contact emails include:

- Internal Complaint Committee & Women Cell — icc@davietjal.org
- Examination Committee — coe@davietjal.org
- Training & Placement Committee — placement@davietjal.org
- Sports Committee — sports@davietjal.org
- Cultural Committee — cultural@davietjal.org
- Website Committee — website@davietjal.org
- Library Committee — librarian@davietjal.org
- Alumni Committee — alumni@davietjal.org
- NSS/Social Welfare Committee — nss@davietjal.org
- Grievances Redressal Committee — studentgrievances@davietjal.org
- Press & Publicity — media@davietjal.org

Other listed committees include Hostel Committee, Timetable Committee, Transport Committee, Students Scholarship Committee, Accreditation Committee, Academic Affairs Committee, Ombudsman/Grievance Committee, and Anti-Ragging Committee.

Committee membership changes over time; always verify the latest office order on davietjal.org.

title: Anti-Ragging Committee (Overview)
content: DAVIET maintains an Anti-Ragging Committee as listed on the Functional Committees page. The Principal is published as Chairman. Membership includes representatives from district administration, police, local media, NGO, faculty, non-teaching staff, parents, and students (as published on the site). For the current full member list and contact numbers, refer to https://davietjal.org/about/functional-committees/ or the Anti-Ragging Committee page, because membership and phone numbers are time-sensitive.
